title: Intrinsic integral constructible objects are bounded and stable under standard truncation
statement: Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a finite-type scheme Y over the geometric field. Every object K of the intrinsic integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] is bounded for the ambient standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. For every integer n both ambient standard truncations tau_LE(n) K and tau_GE(n) K satisfy the same intrinsic integral constructible predicate.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3); integral truncation step of def-weil-constructible-heart

proof.text: Finite type over D.k gives noetherianity and finite dimension. The specified cardinality of D.k0 gives characteristic D.p; the distinct prime l is a unit there, hence in global sections of Y and every local ring. integralStratifiedPerfectDetailed transports intrinsic constructibility by the exact coefficient restriction integralDetailedTransport. The two equivalences of integralStratifiedPerfectCharacterization supply ambient lower and upper bounds. The coefficient restriction is faithful, so the exact-functor boundedness-reflection theorem gives boundedness of the original object. integralStratifiedPerfectClosure supplies membership of both transported standard truncations. The exact-functor truncation isomorphisms identify these with the coefficient transport of the original standard truncations. The uniform-complete triangulation theorem supplies isomorphism closure. Transport membership and apply integralStratifiedPerfectDetailed backwards. All cutoffs, zero objects and the empty scheme are included.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3); integral truncation step of def-weil-constructible-heart

lean.statement:
theorem sfIntegralStandardTruncations
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] :
    ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K.obj ∧ ∀ n : ℤ,
        sfIntegralConstructible l E Y
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE n).obj K.obj) ∧
        sfIntegralConstructible l E Y
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj K.obj)
